row: Here at NEIGHborly Equine Services, I concentrate on giving quality education to my followers and clients. Here you will find videos on all kinds of equine topics. I am a certified equine massage therapist, a professional Dressage trainer, and a professional riding instructor. I received my education at Meredith Manor International Equestrian Centre, as well as through other dressage trainers like Nancy Wesolesk, Karen Graves(KKM Stables), and various clinicians like Alfredo Hernandez, Francis Carbonelle, and Becky Stromatt of Stromatt Sport Horses.
